key_findings: Bladder and urethra afferents in rats project from L5 to S2, mainly to the SPN, lateral lamina V and SDCom, with few terminals in superficial dorsal horn laminae I-III.
Afferent patterning was similar for bladder and urethra and between sexes; SPN preganglionic neurons are absent from rostral L6.
